youtube.title: The GREATEST Randomized Pokemon Soul Link | Part 1 Nuzlocke
youtube.description:
Our Pokemon HeartGold and SoulSilver Randomized Soul Link Nuzlocke begins! Will it be another scufflocke or will having my most veteran Poke player return for another soul link ensure victory? Find out starting today!

Blue: @bluewestlo 

Mr. Fruit's Cherry Limeade: https://advanced.gg/MrFruit (Code MrFruit for 10% off)
Become Awesome: http://bit.ly/SubscribeMrFruit

★ WATCH MORE ★

Pokemon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon Soul Link Nuzlocke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=73AKhaCV4_Y&list=PLoUIEa5ZOZyVfLyCVSerTrZhyib-m_Ro4

★ CONNECT WITH ME ★

Main Channel: @Mr_Fruit 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/MrFruitYT
Twitch: http://www.twitch.tv/MyMisterFruit
Instagram: https://instagram.com/mrfruitgaming/

★ RULES ★

-If a pokemon faints, it must be permanently placed inside PC Box
-Can only catch the first pokemon encountered in each route.
-Must nickname every pokemon caught (will be named after someone in House Fruit)
-Every wild pokemon encounter, static pokemon encounter, trainer pokemon, ability and moveset/learnset are randomized.
-If we black out, we lose.
-No pokemon can exceed level of next gym leaders highest level
-2 Items used in-battle per battle, unless a mon faints then item usage resets in that battle
-Force Fully Evolved Trainer Pokemon At Lvl 40
-If we white out/black out, we lose.
-Each encounter is paired with each other making them "soul linked"
-If one person fails to catch their encounter or knocks it out, the other person forfeits the encounter as well
-If one persons Pokemon in a soul link is put in the PC or knocked out than the other linked Pokemon must follow/share the same fate
-No repeat of primary types across both parties
-No pair may share the same primary typing
-Randomized fossils can be used as an extra encounter in the route the 2nd fossil half was found (both players will need to find 1 fossil for this to come into effect)

rules.title: Simultaneous Playthrough
rules.shortSummary: Both players must playthrough the games simultaneously.

versions.description: The two players play through the same game simultaneously.

Encounters for players on each route are linked. If one player fails to catch their encounter for a route, the other player must box or release their encounter for that route as well. If both players successfully catch their first encounter for the route, those two Pokémon are “linked” as partners.

rules.title: Pokemon Dying
rules.shortSummary: When a pokemon dies, it's partner dies as well.

versions.description: When one player’s Pokémon faints, its partner on the other player’s team must be boxed or released as well.
If a Pokémon is placed in the PC, its partner on the other player’s team must be placed in the PC as well.

rules.title: Restricted Typings
rules.shortSummary: No sharing of the same primary typing.

versions.description: Often, players will restrict the use of shared types between the teams, meaning that no Pokémon on either team may share the same primary type.

rules.title: Randomized Encounters
rules.shortSummary: Pokemon are randomized to promote variety!

versions.description: It’s common to randomize the encounters on each route for this challenge, to promote greater Pokémon and type variety between the teams, especially on early routes where Pokémon selection is limited.
Only the first wild Pokémon encountered in a route or area can be caught. If the player fails to catch it (ie. it flees or faints), their opportunity to catch a Pokémon in that area is lost.
The player must nickname all Pokémon they catch or obtain.

rules.title: Duplicate Clause
rules.shortSummary: To prevent duplicates, and promote variety!

versions.description: If the first Pokémon in an area is one the player already owns, they may continue battling until they encounter one they do not own, and then attempt to catch it. This rule prevents a player from having multiples of the same Pokémon, especially early in the game when the selection of different Pokémon on the first few routes is limited.
If the player encounters a shiny wild Pokémon, they may catch it, even if a wild Pokémon has already been encountered in that area. This does not count as the encounter for that area.

rules.title: Level Cap
rules.shortSummary: No pokemon can exceed the level of the next gym leaders highest level

versions.description: No pokemon can exceed the level of the next gym leaders highest level.

rules.title: 2 Item Limit
rules.shortSummary: Maximum 2 Items used in-battle per battle

rules.title: Fossils are re-rolls
rules.shortSummary: Randomized fossils can be used as an extra encounter in the route the 2nd fossil half was found
